grammar.title: Family News — Reported Speech (Said/Told)
rules: "said (that) + oração" é usado para relatar o que alguém disse, sem mencionar o ouvinte: He said he loved her.
"told + pessoa + oração" é usado quando dizemos a quem foi dito algo; "told" exige objeto: She told me they were getting married.
No discurso relatado, o tempo verbal geralmente recua um passo: "I love her" vira He said he loved her.
Pronomes mudam conforme quem fala: "I want" vira he said he wanted.

rows: reportar dizendo a quem foi dito
She told me they were getting married.
"I love her" → he said he loved her
